verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents splitting model layers across GPU VRAM and system RAM so that a model larger than VRAM can run locally. The closest items do not count: 'Run larger models on Ollama's Cloud' offloads to a hosted service rather than local CPU+GPU, and the community report of 'falling back to CPU' describes a whole-model fallback, not combined offload. The axis clearly applies to a local LLM runner, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
